result:
I fixed the stray-manifest failure in `findTemplateRoot` in `cli/src/lib/core-manifest.ts`. I did not touch or check the plugin-uninstall half of the claim, since the prosecutor did not dispute it.

**Cause:** the guard only skipped a match at the exact `tmpdir()` directory. Under vitest that directory is a per-run folder under `/tmp`. A fixture two levels down still walked up past it and matched a stray `/tmp/core-manifest.json`.

**Fix:** the walk now returns null as soon as it reaches the scratch root, instead of skipping that directory and continuing upward. I also made `tmpdir()` be read when the function runs rather than once at import. `TMPDIR` can be changed after import, and vitest does that per run.

**Verification:** I ran the prosecutor's reproduction against the changed code. I created `/tmp/core-manifest.json` containing `{}`, then ran `npx vitest run src/lib/core-manifest.test.ts src/commands/core-diff src/commands/core-upgrade`. All 4 files and 131 tests passed, including the three that failed before. I then deleted the stray file and reran the same command, which also passed 131 of 131. I did not run the full suite.

I did not update the comment on `findTemplateRoot` that says fixtures sit "one level under /tmp". It is now inaccurate, but you asked me not to touch anything outside the finding.

VERDICT: FIXED
